propositions: Environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY and optional --detected-by flag stamp the detection channel (canary, ci, review-bot, agent, human-audit, user-report, or custom) at ticket creation without user friction.
The detected_by field is normalized by strip() and lowercase; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim with no enum enforcement.
The process_create reducer projects detected_by present-only into compiled state, and tickets created without the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior.
The --detected-by flag overrides the REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable; absence of both leaves the field unset.
The optional detected_by field is declared in ticket_state.schema.json and must be registered in the environment-variable documentation registry.
Jira inbound reconcilers (apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypass composer.create_core and do not capture detected_by to avoid mis-attribution.
